const fs=require('node:fs'),crypto=require('node:crypto');const inputs={"internal/runthrough/outbox_token_exhaustion_controls_test.go": ""};const receipt={};for(const[n,b]of Object.entries(inputs)){const data=Buffer.from(b,'base64');fs.writeFileSync(n,data);receipt[n]=crypto.createHash('sha256').update(data).digest('hex')}console.log(JSON.stringify({testSetupSync:receipt}));
